notes.en: Ranking assumes a balance between a damage oriented scenario and a more supportive one.

note.en: Assumes max stacks. The energy refund part of passive is generally wasted.
Ranking assumes weapon is not overcapped on [[stat:cr]]. This weapon can perform worse if used with a [[stat:cr]] providing artifact set.
The ranking assumes the passive is active every other rotation. If it is not, generally outside of 2 [[element:electro]] teams, this weapon ranks under **[[weapon:aquila-favonia]]**.
Ranking assumes the [[ability:bol]] is not cleared. If the [[ability:bol]] is cleared, this weapon performs notably better, similar to **[[weapon:mistsplitter-reforged]]**.
Do note that the [[stat:cr]] from the passive does not apply to [[element:stellar-glimmer]] DMG.

Ranking assumes both halves of the passive are active, in which case this weapon performs equivalently to **[[weapon:finale-of-the-deep]]** with the [[ability:bol]] not cleared. If you can not trigger reactions with [[character:odette]], this weapon is majorly worse than most other options.
